events.headline: CBSL reviews early-settlement charges and parate execution following borrower complaints
events.summary: CBSL conducted thematic reviews in the first half of 2026 after receiving complaints about charges for early settlement of term loans and banks’ parate execution practices. The early-settlement review covered licensed banks and finance companies; the parate review concerned licensed banks. The report does not announce findings, sanctions or new rules.

events.headline: Bank of Ceylon plans Basel III Tier 2 debenture issue of up to Rs. 30 billion
events.summary: Bank of Ceylon announced a listed subordinated debt issue opening on 3 November 2026. It proposes an initial Rs. 10 billion tranche, with oversubscription options taking the maximum to Rs. 30 billion. The planned Tier 2 debentures include non-viability write-down terms; the amount is a proposed offering, not proceeds already raised.

events.headline: Nations Trust Bank and Union Assurance renew bancassurance partnership
events.summary: Nations Trust Bank and Union Assurance announced the renewal of their exclusive bancassurance partnership. The arrangement continues the distribution of life-insurance protection products through the bank’s customer channels. The report did not disclose new financial commitments or sales volumes.

events.headline: NBFI borrower-risk indicators worsen, with Stage 2 loans up 92.1%
events.summary: CBSL figures reported for June 2026 show that 52.4% of household borrowers at non-bank financial institutions were in high or very-high CRIB risk categories, versus 24.1% at banks. Finance-company Stage 2 loans increased 92.1% year on year, with gold-backed Stage 2 balances up 279.2%. These are risk indicators, not confirmed credit losses.

events.headline: Fitch assigns expected A-(EXP)(lka) rating to Asia Asset Finance subordinated debt
events.summary: Fitch assigned an expected national-scale rating of A-(EXP)(lka) to proposed subordinated listed debentures of up to Rs. 3 billion from Asia Asset Finance. The company intends to use the proceeds to reinforce Tier 2 capital and support loan-book growth. The final rating remains contingent on satisfactory documentation.

events.headline: PDMO rejects all bids in US$ 100 million domestic dollar-bond auction
events.summary: The Public Debt Management Office rejected all bids at its 23 October domestic dollar-bond auction. The proposed issue was US$ 100 million with an option to raise up to US$ 300 million. Market participants suggested bid rates were too high, but the official notice did not provide that explanation.

events.headline: Government-bond yields broadly steady; selected 2033–2034 tenors rise
events.summary: Monday’s secondary-market trading was broadly steady across most government-bond tenors, though selected 2033 and 2034 maturities faced selling pressure and higher yields. The market was preparing for Treasury-bill and Treasury-bond auctions scheduled for 28 and 29 October respectively.

events.headline: Sri Lanka’s exports reach US$ 13.61 billion in January–September 2026
events.summary: Export earnings for the first nine months of 2026 reached US$ 13.61 billion, an increase of 5.04% from a year earlier, according to figures released by Sri Lanka Customs and estimates from the Export Development Board. September exports reached about US$ 1.69 billion, up 17.23% year on year. The nine-month total includes goods and services.

events.headline: Resus Energy’s Rs. 1 billion green bond gains Luxembourg listing
events.summary: Resus Energy announced the dual listing of its Rs. 1 billion green bond on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and its display on the Luxembourg Green Exchange, effective 19 October. The bond was originally listed in Colombo in 2025; the overseas listing expands visibility of an existing security rather than constituting a fresh Rs. 1 billion issue.

events.headline: Government adopts three-month economic forecasting amid energy-price uncertainty
events.summary: A Deputy Minister said the Government is using rolling three-month forecasts to respond to energy and geopolitical price shocks while preserving fiscal buffers and export competitiveness. The report also cites slower real GDP growth of 4.2% in Q2 2026 versus 5.1% in Q1, and outlines plans for 18 industrial zones over the coming one to two years.

events.headline: SLPA report flags delayed Colombo East Terminal commissioning and revenue potential
events.summary: An SLPA operational review identifies equipment, staffing and systems work outstanding at the Colombo East Container Terminal. It estimates annual revenue potential of roughly US$ 180–200 million once fully operational, not revenue currently earned, and describes a commissioning programme running into June 2027.
